entities.summary: Natalya Safronova, is a volleyball player from Russia. During her time playing with the Russian club Zarechie Odintsovo, she won the "Best Attacker" award at the 2006–07 CEV Cup. Natalya Safronova was a athletes & competitors from Krasnoyarsk (b. 1979-02-06, Krasnoyarsk). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
